req.title: Cookies-set returns Set-Cookie per entry
req.statement: The system shall emit one Set-Cookie header per k=v pair passed to /cookies/set.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /cookies/set must emit one Set-Cookie header per k=v pair. The set_cookies() handler iterates request.args and calls r.set_cookie() for each pair, then redirects. Tests must verify: (1) positive - two params yield two Set-Cookie headers with correct names/values; (2) negative - zero params yield zero Set-Cookie headers; (3) boundary - exactly one param yields exactly one Set-Cookie header. Additional tests cover exact header count, exact cookie values, and redirect status to maximize mutation kill rate by asserting exact counts, exact values, and exact status codes.

tests.name: test_cookies_set_two_params_emits_two_set_cookie_headers
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
No pre-existing cookies in test client
actions: Create Flask test client with allow_redirects=False
expected: Exactly two Set-Cookie headers are present
trace: R-HTTPBIN-047: one Set-Cookie per k=v pair
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_cookies_set_two_params_emits_two_set_cookie_headers():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?a=1&b=2', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    set_cookie_headers = r.headers.getlist('Set-Cookie')
    assert len(set_cookie_headers) == 2
    joined = ' '.join(set_cookie_headers)
    assert 'a=1' in joined
    assert 'b=2' in joined

test_cookies_set_two_params_emits_two_set_cookie_headers()

tests.name: test_cookies_set_cookie_values_are_exact_not_swapped
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Create Flask test client with allow_redirects=False
trace: R-HTTPBIN-047: each k=v pair must map correctly, not swapped
DT: decision table covering correct key-value pairing
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_cookies_set_cookie_values_are_exact_not_swapped():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?foo=bar&baz=qux', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    set_cookie_headers = r.headers.getlist('Set-Cookie')
    assert len(set_cookie_headers) == 2
    has_foo_bar = any('foo=bar' in h for h in set_cookie_headers)
    has_baz_qux = any('baz=qux' in h for h in set_cookie_headers)
    has_foo_qux = any('foo=qux' in h for h in set_cookie_headers)
    has_baz_bar = any('baz=bar' in h for h in set_cookie_headers)
    assert has_foo_bar is True
    assert has_baz_qux is True
    assert has_foo_qux is False
    assert has_baz_bar is False

test_cookies_set_cookie_values_are_exact_not_swapped()

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_cookies_set_followed_by_redirect_shows_cookies_in_view():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?mykey=myval', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies']['mykey'] == 'myval'

test_cookies_set_followed_by_redirect_shows_cookies_in_view()
